title: Welcome to the staff room
intro: You play in pairs. Talk about what you hear and agree on your answers. There isn't always one right answer.

sections.heading: Your task
items: Walk around the staff room and the corridor, and talk to all eight people. Each of them tells you about one technology they use in their work.
Place each person on the SAMR and Rogers scales in the menu at the bottom left.
On SAMR, you place the way the person uses that particular technology.
On Rogers, you place the person by when they started using that particular technology, compared with their colleagues here.
Press Done when everyone is placed on both scales. That sends your answers.

sections.heading: Controls
items: Click on the floor to walk there.
Click on a person to talk to them. Press 1-9 to choose a question.
The conversation ends when you say Goodbye, press Esc or walk away.
Drag the people onto the axis. The tip of the pin shows the placement.
The Instructions button shows this guide again.
